caption: The drawing features five distinct rectangular fabric pattern samples arranged on a cream or off-white background. In the upper center-right, there is a large brown square with red, white, and yellow flowers set in the corners and center, accented by green leaves and a textured appearance. To its immediate left, a smaller, light beige square displays a repeating pattern of tiny blue teardrop shapes. Just below this, in the lower left corner, is the largest sample—a tan square featuring small blue floral motifs regularly spaced across it. On the right side, below the brown floral pattern, is a small rectangular sample with a dark brown or black base crisscrossed by horizontal green and vertical yellow lines, creating a plaid-like pattern. Below this, in the lower right, there is a dark brown square with a simple linear white motif resembling a small sprig or leaf. The overall arrangement is organized, with the fabric samples evenly distributed across the page. The name "FRANCIS LICHEN" appears printed in small letters at the bottom right corner.
